methods.calibration: CalibratedClassifierCV (sigmoid/isotonic) fit on validation only, vs uncalibrated baseline; selected by lowest validation Brier score
methods.uncertainty_signals: max-class confidence, top1-top2 margin, Shannon entropy; Low/Medium/High buckets from validation confidence 33rd/66th percentiles
methods.ood_detection: nearest-training-class-centroid cosine distance in each model's own feature space; threshold = validation-score percentile targeting a 5% in-domain flag rate
methods.threshold_selection: lowest validation threshold achieving >= 95% validation accuracy on the trusted subset, frozen before test/challenge evaluation
methods.disagreement: argmax prediction comparison between the two frozen models, accuracy conditioned on agreement/disagreement
